title: What Comet Defense Systems Is
definition: Comet Defense Systems: systems for long-period comet threats.
description:
Comet Defense Systems is systems for long-period comet threats. It sits squarely in Future Safety & Civilization Resilience, the frontier where early warning science becomes system logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are international law-scale. Societies that master system hulls early will shape intercept planning practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why early warning programs worldwide now treat Comet Defense Systems as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Comet Defense Systems needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

description:

What must be true first: the early warning results have to replicate outside the lab, system logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and intercept planning operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed early warning demonstrations, system logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting intercept planning uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Comet Defense Systems
definition: Estimates Comet Defense Systems readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Comet Defense Systems components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a system hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Comet Defense Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Comet Defense Systems operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Comet Defense Systems installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 33332 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where early warning monitoring, system logistics redundancy, or intercept planning maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Comet Defense Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Comet Defense Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Comet Defense Systems — systems for long-period comet threats.

Phase 1 — Prove (early warning): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (system logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (intercept planning): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (international law): system hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and space-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
